people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

translations.web: Babylon will become heaps, a dwelling place for jackals, an astonishment, and a hissing, without inhabitant.
translations.bsb: Babylon will become a heap of rubble, a haunt for jackals, an object of horror and scorn, without inhabitant.
translations.kjv: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwellingplace for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.
translations.asv: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwelling-place for jackals, an astonishment, and a hissing, without inhabitant.
